purpose: Evolving hypotheses about audible likeness, tested with regular human listening including model/metric agreement cases.

hypotheses.claim: A chosen winner can still fail to evoke the reference.
hypotheses.evidence: The neural-v2 quick export contained four best choices; the user separately said only charm2.wav was actually approximated.
hypotheses.nextTest: Retain best/none choices and invite optional close-enough or failure notes; do not relabel all winners as successful recreations.

hypotheses.claim: Models and similarity metrics can agree while sharing an audible blind spot.
hypotheses.evidence: On 2026-10-04 the user requested continued involvement even when models and metrics agree and emphasized developing psychoacoustic theories from listening.
hypotheses.nextTest: Include claimed successes and representative coverage alongside uncertain cases in regular short listening batches.

hypotheses.claim: Some pitch-register and gesture errors matter more than aggregate spectral improvements.
hypotheses.evidence: The user reported poor pitch matching. The forward pilot also found lower actual descriptor loss with substantially worse pitch and motion; this is diagnostic evidence, not a listening validation of a new weighting rule.
hypotheses.nextTest: Compare real renders while preserving already matched reliable pitch and motion. Keep noisy targets outside pitch constraints; ask whether retained pitch/gesture produces better likeness.

hypotheses.claim: An input descriptor with an octave error can make wrong-register reproductions appear plausible to the inverse and matching pipeline.
hypotheses.evidence: The bird reference produced roughly 2.54 kHz in the older pitch diagnostic and 1.23 kHz in the coarse neural descriptor. Clean sine probes isolate descriptor errors: 2,000 Hz becomes roughly 1,002 Hz and 3,200 Hz becomes 1,575 Hz. The older diagnostic itself halves a 4,000 Hz sine. None of the new flat/temporal/mixture raw inverses passed a one-semitone check on four additional high-pitch development probes. This does not isolate the input error as the cause of the full model failures.
hypotheses.nextTest: Version a finer-resolution, confidence-aware input separately; compare actual pitch and human judgments at equal training and render budgets, including metric-consensus cases.

hypotheses.claim: Attack character, event rhythm and tail may explain likeness failures that a pooled spectrum misses.
hypotheses.evidence: User emphasizes large-scale gestural qualities and feel. No causal ablation has established the appropriate balance for this corpus.
hypotheses.nextTest: Use controlled encoder comparisons and optional human failure descriptions; test any inferred rule on different sound families before broad adoption.
